high_level_description: This image is a promotional post for the live-action series "Spider-Noir." The background features a dark, moody setting with a blueish tint, giving it a noir aesthetic. At the top of the image, there is bold white text that reads: "BRENDAN GLEESON HAS BEEN OFFICIALLY CAST AS A VILLAIN IN THE 'SPIDER-NOIR' SERIES." Below this text, smaller white text credits the source as "GEEKSTER | VIA: DEADLINE HOLLYWOOD." The central figure in the image is an illustrated character dressed in a black suit with a mask covering their face
